summary: DOES NOT MEET (class WRONG: gate G3 fails). The enclosure is a clean, well-dimensioned base+lid: board fit 1.10 mm, 4 standoffs on the 65x45 pattern (OD 5.3, pilot Ø2.10 x 5.1 deep), keep-outs clear by 0.10 mm, both 3.5 mm jack openings (Ø8.80 at Y 17.60/32.84, Z 2.5) clear the plug envelopes by 0.40 mm, 0.25 mm lip fit with 2.1 mm engagement, 4 corner screw bosses, 2.4 mm walls/floor/lid, 82.3x62.3x24.7 mm, manifold single-shell bodies, no support needed. But there is NO USB opening: the -X end wall is solid, and the declared layout puts the Pico 5.5 mm inboard (USB_MOUTH X 5.5 instead of -1.8..-0.8), so the micro-USB plug envelope penetrates the wall by 168 mm3 at board-frame [-3.5,20,1.4]-[-1.1,30,8.4]. L1.5 fails (L3.5.1.1, L3.5.2.1, L3.5.3.1), L1.1 fails (L3.1.3.1 USB mouth position; L3.1.6.1 grid residual 1.12, partly a catalogue conflict), L1.12 fails (self-report omits the USB clear_of and its -X aperture check wrongly expects 0 openings). Weighted score about 123/134 = 0.92.
